item.tib: mkha' 'gro seng gdong 'khros ma'i rgyud las zhi ba'i las tshogs thugs rje nyi ma
item.coloph: ces mkha' 'gro seng gdong can gyi rgyud las sgrib sbyong zhi ba'i las tshogs thugs rje nyi ma 'di ni/ snying gi grogs por gyur pa drung yig sa trig pas drag gi tshul mas bskul ba'i ngor/ snyoms las kun grol grags pa 'ja' tshon snying po can gyis drag po zhes lcags pho sprel lo zla 6tshes 13la gnas chen dga' ba pad lung gi gdan sa ri khrod du bgyis pa dge'o//
